author: National Geographic
description:
Bertie Gregory - National Geographic Explorer, wildlife filmmaker, and photographer - takes a seat in the yellow chair to answer the Nat Geo 9. In this interview, learn more about the host of Hammerhead Sharks Up Close, Secrets of the Bees, and Animals Up Close. Find out what advice Bertie would tell to his nine-year-old self, what is his favorite of the seven continents, and the three most important lessons he's learned in life.

author: National Geographic
description:
How do animals survive in Earth's most unforgiving environments? Join host Bear Grylls in this full episode compilation of Hostile Planet from National Geographic, as we journey through brutal grasslands and dense jungles, home to some of the planet’s most breathtaking creatures. Relentless predators and extreme weather–wildfires, icy winters, droughts, unbearable summer heat–create the ultimate battle for survival in the wild. This episode showcases the adaptations and resilience required by wild animals, including elephants, wolves, big cats, snakes, hippos, orangutans, and more, to endure the planet’s most punishing habitats. Only the strongest will have what it takes to make it through.
